title: Customers
summary: A company's customers: code (generated or typed), party type, tax identity as Coretax needs it (NPWP 16, NIK, passport, PKP, VAT collector), billing and shipping addresses with NITKU, contacts, payment days, credit limit, on hold with a reason — deactivated, never deleted. A person's ID masked (an individual's NPWP too) and matched only whole in search; whole only with an access record. Offers CustomerClient (Get, Search, Usable inside a posting's d.Tx, Snapshot for documents). Publishes its lifecycle as events (customers.customer.created/changed/deactivated/activated/held/released).
when_to_use: The app sells to known parties: sales orders, invoices, receivables, deliveries, a POS with member customers.
when_not_to_use: Receivable balances, credit-limit enforcement, tax invoices — the sales, accounting, and tax modules read from this one through their ports.
One customer list shared by several companies — this module keeps each company's own.

permissions.name: customers.manage
permissions.description: Menambah, mengubah, menahan, dan menonaktifkan pelanggan

permissions.name: customers.credit
permissions.description: Mengubah termin pembayaran dan batas kredit pelanggan

permissions.name: customers.sensitive
permissions.description: Melihat NIK dan nomor paspor pelanggan secara utuh

emits.name: customers.customer.created
emits.description: A customer was added: {id, company_id, code, name, party_type}.

emits.name: customers.customer.changed
emits.description: A customer or one of its parts changed: {id, company_id, code, name, part} — part is "customer" (its own fields: name, tax identity, terms…), "address", "contact". Read the current state through the contract; the payload carries no tax ID.

emits.name: customers.customer.deactivated
emits.description: A customer was deactivated: {id, company_id, code, name}. New documents may not use it; its old ones stay.

emits.name: customers.customer.activated
emits.description: A deactivated customer was activated again: {id, company_id, code, name}.

emits.name: customers.customer.held
emits.description: A customer was put on hold: {id, company_id, code, name, reason}. Documents refuse it until released.

emits.name: customers.customer.released
emits.description: A customer was taken off hold: {id, company_id, code, name}.
